featured_reviews.name: Rashi Sinha
featured_reviews.review_text:
I met Dr. Pradnya in May, 2024 for chronic joint pain. She and her team were very compassionate and understanding. We started with modalities and exercises. Our sessions would last for one hour, even more than that. I was regular till August.

Here are some of my highlights:

1. First judgement free healthcare experience in my life. Dr. Pradnya really puts the person first and it made the right impact on me. I trusted her treatment and was motivated to show up.

2. She worked with me and gently pushed me for a second opinion. I was tired of doctor visits and vague diagnoses. She was consistent is letting me know that what I am going through seems like more of a disorder because of multiple joint involvement. I reluctantly followed her advice and finally was motivated to go for another round of doctor appointments. And it rewarded me - I was diagnosed with Psoriatic Arthritis after 4 years of joint pain.

3. We stopped modalities after I was much better and focused on only exercises. We added more aids such as weights and resistance bands and the graded workout helped me in recovery.

4. She was able to make me gym-ready which was my next goal as per the doctor to eventually build more muscle.

All of this would have not been possible without her investment in my healing and her unconditional positive regard for me. Thanks to the whole team for this life changing experience.
